summary.text: Christopher Dardzinski is the U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate for Michigan's 13th District and has appeared on the general-election ballot for this seat before. Ballotpedia lists his career as including business, publishing, writing, economic analysis, political consulting and journalism.

paragraphs.text: Born in Wyandotte, Michigan, in 1967 and raised there, according to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey.
Earned an associate degree from Henry Ford Community College in 1988.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in business and as a publisher, author, economic analyst, political consultant, and journalist; in a 2024 survey he described himself as a former city council member and retired international trade analyst.
Appeared on the general-election ballot for Michigan's 13th District as the U.S. Taxpayers Party candidate in 2022 and 2024, and advanced from the party's July 18, 2026 convention.
